essence: Kapilaksha is recognized as the destroyer of serpent poison.
The six names are used for nyasa starting from fingers and heart.
The deity is to be visualized with these specific bodily features and ornaments.
Takshaka serves as the waist cord and Karkota as the necklace.
Shankhapala adorns the head and Kulika the space between the arms.
